title: rustfmt drift in the engram test modules: keep format-only reflows out of feature diffs
outcome: src/tests/engram_turn_checks.rs, src/tests/engram_lost_shell_overlap.rs and src/tests/engram_one_call_checks.rs are rustfmt-clean on master, so a later change that runs rustfmt over them adds no format-only hunks unrelated to its subject.
acceptance: `rustfmt --edition 2024 --check` reports no diff for src/tests/engram_turn_checks.rs, src/tests/engram_lost_shell_overlap.rs and src/tests/engram_one_call_checks.rs on master, landed as a format-only change.
The full gate passes on the landed tree.
